note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION FINDING: the 86,873 customs records attached to this name are INBOUND imports of notebook/VGA spares from ASUS GLOBAL PTE.LTD. (Singapore) into Sahar Air Cargo ACC, Mumbai — not exports. No export shipment with date, destination and B/L was found; export_status = none_found. Declared HS 847330 does not match the observed inbound codes (83021090 hinges, 84145190 fans) — per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; the actual codes are 83021090/84145190 for the spares trade, and the entity is an importer/distributor rather than an exporter of 847330 parts. Role reads as trader/distribution arm (ASUS group), not manufacturer. Address on record: "4C,GUNDECHA ONCLAVE,KHERANI ROAD SAKI NAKA" (Mumbai area), which conflicts with the claimed state West Bengal — flag for correction, not rejection. PAN AAFCA8787N and revenue/export volume: not verifiable from public sources, left null. Search tooling (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down during this run and volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, so GST turnover and GeM/CPPP checks could not be completed — domestic_status is declared_only, not confirmed. No trace of domestic supplies by this entity itself was found; the reseller names above belong to the parent's counterparty list.
